questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐmen zhèngfǔ rènwéi mùqián dà-, zhōng-, xiǎoxuéde qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng?

answers.answer_text: What does your government think of your colleges, high schools, and primary schools at present?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmen xiǎng Wénhuà Gémìng yǐhòude jiàoyù shuǐpíng bú gòu gāo, wǒmen děi gǎibiàn zhèige qíngxing.

answers.answer_text: We think that since the Cultural Revolution educational standards have not been high enough, and we must change this situation.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhōngguó zhèngfǔ yǒu jìhuade tígāo yíbùfen dàxuéde shuǐpíng.

answers.answer_text: The Chinese government is raising the standards in some universities in a planned way.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ā! Zhèi jiù shi bǎ dàxué fēnchéng yīlèi dàxué èrlèi dàxuéde yuányīn le!

answers.answer_text: Ah! This is the reason that universities are divided into Class I and Class II.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiànzài Shànghǎide jiàoshī shùliàng gòu bu gòu?

answers.answer_text: At present is the number of teachers in Shànghǎi sufficient?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bú gòu, érqiě, zhèi shi yíge pǔbiànde wèntí.

answers.answer_text: No, moreover this is a widespread problem.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bàoshang shuō Měiguó zhōng-xiǎoxuéde tiáojiàn dōu bú cuò.

answers.answer_text: It says in the papers that conditions in American secondary and primary schools are quite good.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì. Jīběnshang měi sānshíge xuésheng yǒu yíwèi jiàoshī, lián zuì pǔtōngde xuéxiào yě yǒu diànshì, túshūguǎn, shénmede.

answers.answer_text: Yes. In general there is a teacher for every thirty students, and even the most ordinary schools have televisions, a library, and so on.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèngfǔ gěi pǔtōng xiǎoxué hé zhòngdiǎn xiǎoxuéde qián duō ma?

answers.answer_text: Does the government give the same amount of money to ordinary elementary schools as to key elementary schools?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yǒu yìdiǎnr chābié. Wǒmen děi shǒuxiān zhàogu zhòngdiǎn xiǎoxué.

answers.answer_text: There is some difference. We must first give consideration to key elementary schools.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhōngguó liúxuéshēng xuéxíde zhòngdiǎn shi zìrán kēxué ba?

answers.answer_text: Chinese students abroad concentrate on the natural sciences, isn't that so?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duìle, shi kēxué jìshu.

answers.answer_text: Right, on science and technology.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐmende yánjiūshēng chū guó xuéxí yǐhòu dōu huí dàxué jiāo shū ma?

answers.answer_text: After going abroad to study, do all your graduate students go back to the universities and teach?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù. Yǒu yíbùfen děi dānrèn jìshu fāngmiànde lǐngdǎo gōngzuò.

answers.answer_text: No. Some of them have to take up leading posts in technical fields.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jīngguò sānniánde nǔlì, zhèige dìqūde nóngyè shēngchǎn tiáojiàn xiànzài bú cuò le.

answers.answer_text: After three years of effort, conditions for agricultural production in this area are now quite good.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Guānyú zhèige wèntí, nǐmen yǒu méiyou cáiliào, wǒmen kě bu kěyi dàihuiqu kànkan?

answers.answer_text: Do you have any data on this subject that we could take back with us to read?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yào shíxiàn Sìge Xiàndàihuà zuì dàde wèntí shi shénme?

answers.answer_text: What is the biggest problem in achieving the Four Modernizations?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shi jīngjì. Wǒmen děi zài bù tài chángde shíjiānlǐ bǎ zhěnggè guójiāde jīngjì gǎoshangqu.

answers.answer_text: It's the economy. Before too long we must push ahead the economy of the whole country.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒmende liúxuéshēng tíchulai jǐge wèntí.

answers.answer_text: Our foreign exchange students have brought up a few problems.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ tīngshuō le, tāmen xiǎng jiākuài xuéxí sùdù. Wǒmen yídìng kǎolǜ.

answers.answer_text: I heard. They want to speed up the pace of their studies. We'll be sure to consider it.
